title: One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC) & Mera Ration
target_audience: NFSA ration card holders, migrant laborers, and rural/urban poor families.
benefits: Collect entitled subsidized or free foodgrains (wheat/rice) from ANY Fair Price Shop (FPS / Ration Dukan) across India using Aadhaar biometric authentication.
eligibility: All NFSA (Priority Household & Antyodaya Anna Yojana) card holders.
documents_needed: Ration Card number and Aadhaar linked with ration database.
how_to_apply: Download 'Mera Ration' mobile app to find nearest FPS dealer, check monthly quota, or link Aadhaar at Fair Price Shop.

title: Voter ID Card Online Registration & Correction (Form 6/8)
target_audience: Citizens who completed 18 years of age or need address change/corrections on EPIC card.
benefits: Constitutional right to vote in General, State, and Panchayat elections with digital downloadable e-EPIC card on mobile phone.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18+ on qualifying dates (Jan 1, Apr 1, Jul 1, Oct 1).
documents_needed: Passport photo, Proof of Age (Birth Certificate/Aadhaar/10th Marksheet), Proof of Ordinary Residence (Electricity bill/Aadhaar/Rent receipt).
how_to_apply: Apply on voters.eci.gov.in (ECI Voters Portal) or Voter Helpline Mobile App using Form 6 (new voter) or Form 8 (shifting/correction).

title: Electricity Outage (1912) & Municipal Water Grievance
target_audience: Residents experiencing prolonged power blackouts, transformer failure, or tap water supply contamination.
benefits: Direct registration of electricity outage tickets with DISCOM control room and automated lineman dispatch for rapid power restoration.
eligibility: All domestic, agricultural, and commercial power consumers.
documents_needed: Consumer Account Number (CA number / Consumer ID on electricity bill).
how_to_apply: Dial 1912 (National Electricity Emergency Helpline) or state DISCOM toll-free number from any registered mobile phone.

title: Common Service Centers (CSC) & e-District Certificates
target_audience: Citizens needing Income, Caste, Domicile, Birth, or Death certificates.
benefits: Legally valid, digitally signed government certificates issued within statutory timeframe without visiting government offices repeatedly.
eligibility: All residents of the respective state/district.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Passport photo, Self-declaration/Pradhan report, Land/Tax receipt, Old family caste certificate (if caste applied).
how_to_apply: Visit nearest CSC Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE) or apply directly on state e-District portal (e.g. edistrict.up.gov.in, etc.).

title: Swachhata App for Garbage, Street Light & Drainage Issues
target_audience: Urban and rural residents facing uncollected garbage, open drains, dead animal removal, or broken streetlights.
benefits: Geotagged photo-based complaint directly assigned to local municipality sanitary inspector with mandatory resolution within 24 to 48 hours.
eligibility: Any citizen living in municipal corporation, municipality, or cantonment board limits.
documents_needed: Mobile phone with camera and GPS location.
how_to_apply: Download 'Swachhata-MoHUA' app, take photo of garbage dump/pothole/streetlight, and submit in 1 click.

title: UTS on Mobile App for Unreserved Train & Platform Tickets
target_audience: Railway commuters taking general unreserved coaches, passenger trains, and suburban local trains.
benefits: Skip long ticket counter queues at railway stations, book paperless unreserved train tickets and platform tickets in seconds, with 3% wallet bonus on R-Wallet recharge.
eligibility: All railway passengers with Android or iOS smartphone.
how_to_apply: Download 'UTS' app by CRIS, keep GPS on, book within 50 meters to 5 km radius outside railway track zone.

title: Aadhaar Card Update, Correction & PVC Card Ordering
target_audience: Citizens needing mobile number linking, address update, or physical durable PVC Aadhaar card.
benefits: Keep Aadhaar biometric and demographic data current for smooth DBT welfare benefits, bank account operation, and SIM card verification.
documents_needed: Proof of Address (Electricity bill, Ration card, Passport, Bank passbook) for address update.
how_to_apply: Update address online on myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in. For mobile number / biometric update, visit nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra / Post Office.

title: DigiLocker Government Verified Digital Documents Wallet
target_audience: Students, drivers, and citizens wanting paperless official documents.
benefits: Legally valid digital copies of Driving License, Vehicle RC, Insurance, 10th/12th Marksheet, Caste Certificate, and PAN card under Rule 9A of IT Rules 2016.
eligibility: Any citizen having Aadhaar linked with mobile number.
how_to_apply: Sign up on digilocker.gov.in or DigiLocker app, search issuing authority, and pull verified digital certificates.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) House Construction & Geo-Tagging
target_audience: Homeless families or families living in kutcha/dilapidated houses in rural or urban areas.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 Lakh (plains) to ₹1.30 Lakh (hilly areas) for PMAY-Gramin, plus 90-95 days of MGNREGA wages and ₹12,000 for toilet construction.
eligibility: Deprived households listed in Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) or Awaas+ list with no pucca house anywhere in India.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account, Land/Patta document, MGNREGA Job Card.
how_to_apply: PMAY-G selection is done through Gram Sabha. Track instalment release on pmayg.nic.in via registration number.

title: Bus & Public Transit Passes for Senior Citizens, Students & Divyangjan
target_audience: Senior citizens (60+), students, and persons with disabilities using state transport buses (SRTC).
benefits: Concession of 50% to 100% on state road transport buses (KSRTC, UPSRTC, PRTC, MSRTC, DTC etc.) and dedicated priority seating.
eligibility: Senior citizens, bonafide school/college students, and Divyangjan with UDID card.
documents_needed: Age proof / UDID card / School ID, Passport photo, Residence proof.
how_to_apply: Apply at local State Roadways Bus Depot pass counter or state roadways portal.
